LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_NurseUniform.label: [Raven] Nurse Uniform
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_NurseUniform.description: A clean uniform frequently worn by Raven Fusang medical personnel. The cut provides ample space for Raven wings and tail feathers, allowing for rapid movement between hospital beds and the battlefield.
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_NurseCap.label: [Raven] Nurse Cap
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_NurseCap.description: A soft hat used by Raven Fusang nurses to indicate their medical status. It is lightweight and does not interfere with the movement of ear feathers.
